name: Potato Soup
description: A creamy potato soup with carrots, onions, and bacon, finished with sour cream and butter for added richness.
recipeIngredient: 1 Oxo Chicken cube dissolved in 2 cups (8 oz) water + 1 cup water

recipeInstructions.text: Cook vegetables (potatoes, carrots) in 6 cups water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Microwave onions and butter until soft, about 2 minutes.
Add the cooked onion and butter mixture to the vegetables and stir.
Make a roux by stirring flour into 1 cup water until smooth, then add to the soup.
Add more water (up to 1 more cup) to achieve desired consistency.

keywords: potato soup, creamy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Microwave Corn Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy corn chowder made in the microwave with potatoes, carrots, celery, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 2 cans (14¾ oz each) cream style corn

recipeInstructions.text: Place water in a 2-quart microwave-safe dish; cover and heat until boiling.
Add potatoes, carrots, celery, onion, salt, and pepper. Cook, uncovered, on high for 8 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender; set aside (do not drain).
In a 3-quart dish, microwave butter on high for 50 to 60 seconds or until melted.
Stir in flour until smooth. Gradually stir in milk. Cook, uncovered, on high for 6 to 7 minutes or until thickened, stirring every 2 minutes.
Add the cheese. Heat for 1 to 1½ minutes or until the cheese is melted.
Stir in corn and reserved vegetables. Cook on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until heated through.

_similar.keywords: microwave corn chowder, creamy soup, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Creamy Broccoli Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and comforting broccoli soup made with potatoes, chicken broth, and a touch of Miracle Whip for richness.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large saucepan, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add potatoes and broccoli. Simmer for 10 minutes or until tender.
Purée the mixture in a blender until smooth.
Pour the puréed mixture back into the saucepan. Using a whisk, blend in Miracle Whip and seasonings.
Heat the soup thoroughly, stirring occasionally, until warmed through. Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: creamy broccoli soup, potato soup, comforting soup

_similar.name: Cream of Asparagus Soup
_similar.description: A creamy and smooth asparagus soup made with canned asparagus, perfect for serving year-round with optional fresh garnishes.
recipeIngredient: 2 (12 oz) cans asparagus tips or cuttings

recipeInstructions.text: Chop onions and celery medium fine and sauté in butter until limp but not brown.
Add flour and stir for 1 minute.
Gradually add chicken stock (dissolve bouillon cubes in water) and stir until smooth.
Bring to a boil, then add canned asparagus including liquid and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes.
Purée the soup in a blender and press through a sieve for a smooth texture.
To serve, bring soup to a boil, remove from heat, and stir in whipping cream.
Season to taste and keep warm over low heat without boiling.

_similar.keywords: asparagus soup, creamy soup, canned asparagus

_similar.name: Cheesy Ham Chowder
_similar.description: A creamy, cheesy ham chowder with potatoes, carrots, and corn, finished with crispy bacon.

recipeInstructions.text: In a large soup kettle or Dutch oven, cook the bacon over medium heat until crisp. Remove to paper towels to drain.
In the bacon drippings, sauté the chopped onion until tender.
Stir in the flour until blended. Gradually add the milk and water, bringing to a boil. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened.
Add the potatoes, corn, bouillon granules, and pepper. Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Add the shredded cheese and cubed ham; heat until cheese is melted. Stir in the cooked bacon.

_similar.keywords: ham chowder, cheesy soup, comfort food

_similar.name: Mushroom Soup
_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: mushroom soup, creamy soup, comfort food
